hooks.command: if [ -f package.json ]; then npm run lint --if-present; fi

t=$(jq -r '.agent_type // empty' 2>/dev/null); [ "$t" = "worker-implementer" ] && { b=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null | tr '/' '-'); b=${b:-unknown}; mkdir -p docs/swarm/worker-runs; echo "[$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)] Worker finished on $b. Checker required before completion." >> "docs/swarm/worker-runs/$b.md"; }; exit 0
